notes.title: The day has finally arrived! The massive, FREE Huge Update for Deconstruction Simulator is available right now! 🚀

items.text: This update fundamentally changes the way you play, introducing entirely new mechanics: from precise roof dismantling and material recovery to actually building your own modular homes and expanding your business.

To help you get familiar with these massive changes, we have gathered the key features below in a quick visual guide. Remember that you can always find all of these tutorials directly in the game by opening your Decopedia!

The Modular Construction Warehouse is the operational hub of your new specialization. It houses the Prefabricator, storage areas, and the equipment required to handle building modules. This is where you manufacture, store, and prepare wall and roof modules for transport to construction sites.

House Designs unlock access to new modular house construction contracts. Each new design allows you to take on more challenging jobs and build larger, more prestigious properties. Purchase your first design and begin your journey into modular home construction!

The Prefabricator is used to produce modules required for modular house construction contracts. To get started, first purchase a house blueprint in the House Designs tab. Buying a blueprint unlocks new contracts that require construction of the selected house.

The Overhead Crane is used inside the warehouse to transport completed building modules. It allows you to pick up modules produced by the Prefabricator and place them onto a truck trailer or in a storage area. Due to their size and weight, modules cannot be moved by hand.

Roofs don't have to be demolished right away! They can be dismantled piece by piece, allowing you to recover valuable materials. Remove roof tiles, OSB boards, and structural planks, then place them on the appropriate pallets. Careful work will help you recover more resources and increase your contract profit.

You can now build walls and roofs to complete missing sections on contracts. Use recovered materials to construct new structures and repair damaged ones. Each wall requires structural beams, planks, and OSB boards, so be sure to gather the necessary resources before you start building.

Modular homes are built from prefabricated modules produced in the Prefabricator. After transporting them to the construction site, use a crane to place each module into its designated ghost slot. Construction is completed level by level — wall modules are placed first, followed by roof modules. Every module must be placed in the correct slot to complete the construction.

New resources mean new opportunities! You can now recover additional materials while dismantling buildings. Take apart roofs to collect roof tiles and OSB boards. Recovered resources can be used for construction and module production.

Did you remember to bring a board pallet in your vehicle? You'll need it when dismantling roofs made of OSB boards. Carefully remove the individual sections and stack the recovered boards onto the pallet.
Don't forget your roof tile pallet! It allows you to recover materials while dismantling roofs. Carefully remove roof tiles and place them onto the pallet to avoid damage.

Building contracts are not limited to walls and roofs. Some tasks require you to place furniture and interior elements in their designated locations. Place each object in the correct position to complete all required placements and finish the contract.

Scaffold Segments provide safe access to elevated work areas during demolition and construction contracts. Purchase them in the shop, transport them to the contract site, and stack them to build a temporary scaffold tower. The higher the roof, the more segments you may need.
Grab your hammer, jump into the game, and let us know what you think about the new features!

notes.title: 🏠 Build Modular Houses & Create Prefabricated Elements

items.text: A brand-new construction system is coming!

You will be able to create prefabricated building elements and use them to assemble modular houses according to contract requirements. Produce the necessary parts, transport them to the construction site, and complete projects step by step.
Roofs are getting a complete overhaul!
Old roof models are being replaced with new variants, including roofs that can be dismantled piece by piece. Take apart structures more precisely and recover valuable materials along the way.
More details in construction!
New tasks will challenge you to complete interiors and finish buildings by placing furniture, decorations, walls, doors, windows, and other elements exactly where they belong.
Got to town with new heavy equipment!
Use the new crane and prefabricator to create building modules, move them onto trucks, and deliver them directly to your construction projects.
Deconstruct to construct!
You will be able to recover new materials such as OSB boards, tiles, and other building elements directly from structures. These resources can then be reused in future projects and contracts.
Your workplace is growing!

A new production hall is being added for manufacturing prefabricated elements, while the existing facility is being expanded with more space and improved functionality. You can now go outside and explore your growing company!
This update brings a whole new dimension to Deconstruction Simulator. Combine destruction, construction, logistics, and creativity like never before. 🛠️
Get ready to build, dismantle, recover, and create on a bigger scale!
See you on the building site!
Deconstruction Simulator Team
We know you have an eye for good old deconstruction, but now we will see if you have the sense of a builder. Time to see what you can do with hammer and resources you got on previous contracts:

The contract system has been significantly expanded, introducing new types of jobs that let you take part in even more stages of the construction process. From structural work to the finishing touches, every project now offers greater variety and a stronger sense of progression.

Each contract feels more dynamic, challenging you to plan ahead, manage your resources efficiently, and see your work transform into completed buildings. We do not want you to now become a construction company, but we wanted to create system that are intertwined with each other instead of being separate world, Deconstruction contracts that are giving you resources you can use for new types of contract.
Construction contracts have become much more hands-on! You'll now be responsible for erecting walls and assembling roofs using reclaimed materials you've gathered along the way.

Every building starts with a solid foundation, and it's up to you to bring each structure to life piece by piece. Before getting to work, make sure you've collected all the required materials. Good preparation is the key to completing projects efficiently and keeping construction moving forward. 🔨
You will be able to put in windows and doors, being a part of each building process.
Every building also requires a roof, which now will be fully for you to create!
Your work doesn't end once the walls are standing. New contracts also include furnishing and fitting out completed buildings with the required equipment.

Construction sites now feature dedicated installation points where furniture and other interior elements must be placed. Carefully position each item in its designated location to meet the project's requirements and deliver a fully finished building that's ready for use.
From construction to decoration, you'll now oversee the entire process and experience the satisfaction of watching every project come together from start to finish.
See you on the building site!
Deconstruction Simulator Team
Last time we talked about prefabricators and how you are making house modules, and today we're putting them to use! 🏗️
You already saw in previous post how the modules are made so here is step by step how you handle them:
After the modules are delivered to the construction site, the player uses a crane to transport and assemble them.
Each type of wall module has a designated installation location where it must be placed.
Placing a module in the correct slot automatically attaches it to the building's foundation.
Construction progresses in stages, requiring subsequent parts of the structure to be completed in the proper order.
Wall modules are installed first, forming the main structure of the house.
Once the wall assembly is completed, the roof module installation stage becomes available. Completing the installation of both the walls and the roof results in the completion of the modular house.

This system will make you think what resources to save and store! Previously you could just destroy everything in deconstruction contracts but now you will have to think what can handle a quick work and what you will need to do slower to save resources and use for the construction contracts! 🧱
Alongside new mechanics we are adding more contracts to fit them. With the update you will get a new array of jobs allowing you to become not only a deconstructor but also a builder!
However we do not want to completely separate the two aspects of gameplay, we want both to be an intertwined part of the experience.
See you on the building site!
Deconstruction Simulator Team

notes.title: Today we’re rolling out some big guns in another piece of information about the updates. Heavy Machinery is turning on, powerful and loud and we’re all about them right now. 🔨

items.text: Let’s get right to it!
One of the biggest pieces of equipment in your second hangar!

With the new building contracts you will be able to create modular houses using blueprints and most importantly all the resources that you get from the deconstruction contracts! Everything you had, everything you kept in your warehouse is for you to use in the creation of the houses for your clients! You will have various options to choose from and experience.

The finished modules leave the production line one after another. The player must pick them up from the conveyor belt and place them on a truck or in a designated storage area to free up space for the next components.
The modules you will be making the prefabricator will be heavy and unable for you to carry by hand and that is why we are adding another machinery!

After the modules are delivered to the construction site, the player uses a crane to unload and precisely assemble the individual segments of the house according to the chosen design. Correct placement of the modules is essential for completing the subsequent stages of construction and fulfilling the contract.
See you on the building site!
Deconstruction Simulator Team

notes.title: Another day, another moment for more news about Development Update! Let's get right to it! 🔨

items.text: Today we are talking about new aspects of your workplace! More room, more possibilities, and more ways to expand your operations as your company grows. We wanted the workspace to feel more alive and more capable of supporting your efforts!

We added also space allowing you to go outside. More space and more functionality, giving your company grounds a more open feeling and creating opportunities for future additions beyond the warehouse walls. The outside area is not just visual but to help with making the workplace feel more immersive and connected!

As completely new types of contracts and work is coming to your company, we added a second warehouse specifically for that. A second warehouse, a second heart for creating new building elements. This new workspace is designed around entirely different production needs and will play a major role in the new era of Deconstruction Simulator. More on that soon!
See you on the building site!
Deconstruction Simulator Team
Exciting time has arrived! As we are getting closer to the update itself we will be releasing a bit more details about the content in several upcoming posts.
Today we are talking about Roof Dismantling and giving materials a second life.
Let’s get to it! 🔥

We have completely changed the way roofs work. They are now made of parts, which you can detach piece by piece. You can work with them one by one, and later take in with you to your warehouse. Don't fall down!

Because of this new addition we have completely changed the design of roofs and created new variants. Now you can trully work on the houses from top to bottom, from roof to foundation. WIth the new addition we have changed roofs of all older houses into new variants that you will be able to experience.
But why are you doing it in the first place?

With the building mode you will need a lot of resources, old and new. You will need to get roof tiles, which you can obtain from dismantling roofs, OSB boards, bricks, planks and plenty of them to satisfy your clients. 🏘️
New contracts now can ask you not only to deconstruct a part or entire house, but also to build something new.
Nothing now goes unused, everything has it's use, every part of house it's components you can use on your own. A beautiful loop of deconstruction to construction! 🔨

This is just a first part of what is coming, but we will unravel everything with time! More post are coming soon, with plenty of new tidbits of what you will be able to do in the new era of Deconstruction SImulator.
See you on the building site!
Deconstruction Simulator Team

Hey everyone!
We’ve just released a new update for the Deconstruction Simulator demo - a small hotfix that addresses a few key issues reported by players.
Thanks so much for playing and sharing your feedback! 🙌

We have fixed an issue where a contract requiring the demolition of a house required the destruction of all objects in the house. Now, the game does not require you to find every single item to complete the task. We have also changed the task progress display from numbers to percentages.
We have fixed a bug that caused some furniture to disappear from maps after leaving and returning to the contract location.
We have fixed an issue that could cause players to get stuck in the tutorial due to insufficient debris to collect .
Translations for all languages have been improved.
See you soon
Deconstruction Simulator Team
We talked about a bunch of improvements in our previous devlogs, new contracts, new mechanics, new modes. All those exciting aspects, but no way to try them out...
We have released the new version of the Demo RIGHT NOW, with a magnificent amount of improvements, many of which were mentioned in our devlogs.
Well no point in keeping your restless hammers waiting.
Exciting new contracts, including a contract for a multi-story house. 🏚️

Two game modes: Relaxed and Standard. The first allows players to play without penalties and with fewer time limits, while the second is the intended Deconstruction Simulator experience, with all its challenges. ⚙️
Two furniture dismantling modes: Simplified and Standard. Simplified makes dismantling faster and less complicated. You can change it in the game settings. 🧰
Access to a wrecking ball. One of the contracts allows you to see how the wrecking ball control system works. 🏗️
Improved demolition. The hammer has become more precise, and the new sound effects make destruction extremely satisfying. 🔨
Even more interesting house interiors. Every house in the game has gained a LOT of detail, which you can get a taste of in the demo. 🏡
Improved visuals. Deconstruction Simulator looks even better than before. 👀
Improved optimization. The game runs noticeably better than Prologue, especially on less powerful devices. 🎞️
Significant changes to gameplay balance. Both contracts and orders have been better adapted to player expectations, providing a more satisfying deconstruction. 🤑
A whole host of fixes and improvements over the prologue. We've fixed hundreds of bugs and rebuilt several systems to ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience. 🛠️
For now, Deconstruction Simulator Demo is the latest and most refined version of the game available. If you want the best experience, this is the one to play.
To get yourself hyped, check out our demo trailer! 👇
All of your feedback helped us immensely in creating this update and in realizing our focus with Deconstruction Simulator! 💬
A bunch of your voices came from our official Discord, so how about joining us? 😎
See you out in the field!
Deconstruction Simulator Team

notes.title: Thanks to your feedback about the AI placeholder voice in the free Prologue, we decided not to wait any longer. We're thrilled to introduce the real voice of Deconstruction Simulator

items.text: 🎤 Nick Atlas – a pro voice actor whose work you might’ve heard in Dune: Spice Wars, Cultic, Spotify ads, and even Chevrolet.

In the Prologue and Full Version of the game Nick brings life, personality, and a bit of attitude to both our protagonist and the grumpy boss from the beginning of the game. The difference is night and day – trust us, you'll hear it immediately.
This isn’t just a patch. It’s a major upgrade to the feel of the whole experience for that what's is waiting for you in the Full Version of the Deconstruction Simulator
